en: Black-and-white panoramic view over a European riverside city, photographed from a high stone terrace or fortification wall where several people are leaning on the parapet. Below is a wide river with at least two steam-powered boats with tall funnels. A sturdy stone-and-metal bridge spans the river; on the near bank the bridge has a massive stone arch, and on the far bank the shoreline is mostly open sand. Behind the bridge rises a dense cityscape of 19th‑century townhouses and larger villas on the slopes of low hills. In the farther hills there are scattered buildings and a prominent structure on a hilltop. The overall style and technology suggest an early 20th‑century European city postcard.
